import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import metrics

results = [{"score": 71}, {"score": None}, {"score": 88.5}, {"score": 64}, {"score": 93}]
print(metrics.exam_summary(results))
print(metrics.exam_summary([{"score": None}]))
print(metrics.exam_summary([{"score": 50}]))
lines = ["GET /a 120ms", "GET /b 80ms", "malformed", "POST /c 310.5ms", "GET /d 12s"]
print(metrics.describe_response_times(lines))
print(metrics.describe_response_times([]))
print(metrics.describe_response_times(["GET /x 7ms"]))
print("ok")
